meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 让 NanoClaw 直接从 .env 读取 Anthropic 凭证(API key 或 OAuth token),并作为环境变量传进容器,不再经过 OneCLI 网关。Claude 的 API 请求就用这份 .env 凭证认证。
howto.when: 在 .env 里设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并填入 API key 或 OAuth token,重启 NanoClaw 后容器启动时生效;标志未设置时该功能不触发,仍走 OneCLI 网关。

say.text: 帮我启用 .env 凭证模式,跳过 OneCLI 网关。
say.note: 会设置标志并从 .env 读取凭证。

say.text: 把 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 从 .env 注入到容器里。
改用 Claude 订阅 token 认证,不用 API key。
say.note: 会引导你设置订阅 token 并写入 .env。

howto.what_en: Makes NanoClaw read Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from .env and pass them into the container as environment variables, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. Claude's API requests authenticate with these .env credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env with a valid API key or OAuth token, after restarting NanoClaw. Without the flag, it does nothing and the OneCLI gateway stays.

say_en.text: Enable .env credential mode and skip the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Sets the flag and reads credentials from .env.

say_en.text: Inject ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env into the container.
Switch to Claude subscription token auth instead of API key.
say_en.note: Guides you to run claude setup-token and store it in .env.
